name: Link
summary: Inline text link (a) with underline control and optional new-window trailing icon.

props.name: newWindow
props.description: Shows trailing icon, sets target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer", adds sr-only text.

props.name: iconVerticalAlign
props.description: Trailing icon alignment against wrapped text.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render the child (e.g. router Link) instead of <a>. The new-window icon is not added in this mode.

constraints.rule: Use Link for navigation; use Button for actions.
